blurb: Guests board vintage passenger coaches for scenic excursions through Kentucky's Bluegrass countryside. The museum features historic locomotives, interactive exhibits, and special themed event rides. The experience connects visitors to Kentucky's railroad history with volunteer-run operations and family-friendly programs.
extraNote: Departures every weekend, April through September · Closed major holidays; call ahead for group visits · Woodford County Park, 175 Beasley Road, Versailles, Kentucky 40383 · April through September for regular excursions; special events continue into winter
